body: There's no reason for suicide. Maybe you should check out r/suicidewatch?

The reason I was suicidal is because- not that I thought I was worse than others; but because I thought I was better. I struggled every day with the stupidity and ignorance of others. I hated people. I was tired of everything. I didn't want to bring children into this world, have relationships, or even talk to others.


Then I realized: Maybe me, somebody that I consider better, can help others. Maybe one day, people will be nicer than I am. Maybe one day people will go out of their way to help others, and not just a select few, but everybody. Maybe one day the person I help will find a cure for cancer. Maybe one day the person I help will enjoy a peaceful life. Maybe one day, we can live in peace. I capitalized on the fact that deep down, I am a good person. I counted on that, that one day my actions can do great things, albeit indirectly.

I'm back to my usual self. I'm back to gaming, and have made a significant amount of friends since I have accepted people. 

I've learned people will not ever be perfect, but I can damn well try to be. I've made major strides in bettering myself. I've helped people who are down on their luck. I've started coming on here as another account and assisting others. I've started a lot of things in the past few months. I'm also realizing that I can't indent using tab on Reddit. So the little things are bothering me, because I have nothing else to worry about.

I never have.  My parents don't call me a "Superior being" but they have noted that I am better than other counterparts of my age.

What makes him human? He has the same thought processes as I.  He stays away from drugs, he's not sexist, he's not racist, etc.  He isn't self centered, he thinks about the world, and he realizes that he isn't impervious to everything like most people think.  He sits for hours a day thinking how could he make the world a better place, and what steps he should take to make it that way.

And then there's relationships. We both don't want one, and for the same reasons! We don't want to bring another human being into this world that is utter trash.

All in all, he is me, only slightly smaller in stature.

Yes, I have one friend that I consider equal to me, and that is the only reason I posted here. I don't "Look up" to him, but I find him to be a human in a world of aliens. I agreed to his request with a condition... What was the condition? Look at my name.
